latest.title: A page for every site, and a roster you can type in
latest.summary: Every site's page now leads with the warnings about that site, and hovering one lights the part of the page that shows why. Shops and offices gain a profit rank among your trading sites, trend sparks and a cost bar, satisfaction against the 80 line with a lamp for each amenity, what pulls customers in, the ceiling each busy hour ran into, and a crew view that folds big rosters into one row per role. Depots and factories get pages of their own for the first time: a seven-day rail for each item with its delivery truck, what each depot feeds, a square for every machine filled by how much of the week it is staffed, and the inputs each line eats. A home opens from its map card. Shops also get a Roster: the week cut into long shifts up to the game's 12-hour limit, people placed where their schedule demands hold, cleaning and security covered, how many to hire for each role, and lines you tick off as you enter them in BizMan; the Optimize staffing card on Today opens the shop where it saves the most typing. Gyms, hairdressers, theatres and nightclubs now get at-the-ceiling and overstaffed warnings, and switching a warning kind off moves its smaller findings to the bottom of the list and says so.
